_comment: The whole three-block bench in one model, for every display context -- the block itself is drawn by the three column models, which is why this lives in item/ and not block/. Rotation and scale are as authored in the .bbmodel; the gui translation is recomputed by the generator so the icon is centred in its slot (as authored it hung a sixth of the bench off the left edge). The same model serves every display context -- in hand it is just the bench at the small scale the .bbmodel authors for the hand transforms.
